les: Die water begin nie by die kraan nie
kaps_punt: Water as belangrike basiese behoefte: Belangrikheid van water; Verskillende maniere om water te bespaar; en Verskillende maniere om die kwaliteit van water te beskerm.

items.bewering: Jy sweet wanneer jy in die son hardloop of hard werk. Jy verloor ook water wanneer jy toilet toe gaan.
items.blok: Hoekom ons elke dag water nodig het
items.bron: Open University (OpenLearn), water balance: water is lost in sweat, breathing, faeces and urine, most in urine; Better Health Channel (Victoria), 'Water - a vital nutrient' (https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/health/healthyliving/water-a-vital-nutrient). Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Jou liggaam stoor nie water vir môre nie, en jy moet elke dag drink.
items.blok: Hoekom ons elke dag water nodig het
items.bron: Better Health Channel (Victoria): 'As the body can't store water, we need fresh supplies every day to make up for losses' (https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/health/healthyliving/water-a-vital-nutrient); McGill Office for Science and Society, 'water myth' (https://www.mcgill.ca/oss/article/health-nutrition/water-myth): no real way to store excess water.

items.bewering: Kos word ook met water gekook en klere daarmee gewas. Die toilet spoel met water, en mielies op die land groei daarmee. Diere drink dit.
items.blok: Hoekom ons elke dag water nodig het
items.bron: Department of Water and Sanitation, NWRS 2004 Chapter 2 (https://www.dws.gov.za/Documents/Policies/NWRS/Sep2004/pdf/Chapter2.pdf): domestic, agricultural (irrigation) and livestock water use; DWS household water-saving tips (https://www.gov.za/water-saving-tips) on toilet flushing, washing and cooking uses.

items.bewering: 'n kliniek kan sonder water nie mense veilig help nie.
items.blok: Hoekom ons elke dag water nodig het
items.bron: WHO/UNICEF, 'Almost 2 billion people depend on health care facilities without basic water services' (https://www.who.int/news/item/14-12-2020-almost-2-billion-people-depend-on-health-care-facilities-without-basic-water-services-who-unicef): without water, hand hygiene and safe care cannot be ensured; UNICEF data page: 'without water, a health care facility isn't a health care facility'.

items.bewering: Suid-Afrika is 'n droë land, en ons kry nie elke jaar genoeg reën nie.
items.bron: DWS National Water Resource Strategy 2004, Chapter 2 (https://www.dws.gov.za/Documents/Policies/NWRS/Sep2004/pdf/Chapter2.pdf) and GCIS SA Yearbook water chapter (https://www.gcis.gov.za/sites/default/files/docs/resourcecentre/yearbook/chapter24.pdf): average rainfall about 450 mm a year against a world average of about 860 mm; rainfall and river flow are erratic, with recurring droughts. Die sin lees natuurlik as 'nie elke jaar nie' (sommige jare nie), wat die bronne steun.

items.bewering: Reënwater loop in strome af, en 'n groot muur keer dit in 'n dam op.
items.bron: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries, 'dam' (https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/dam): a barrier built across a river to hold back water; South African English sense: an artificial lake where rain or spring water is collected and stored.

items.bewering: Ander reënwater sak diep in die grond en bly daar gebêre.
items.bron: DWS, Groundwater Protection Awareness pamphlet, September 2019 (https://www.dws.gov.za/groundwater/Documents/Inhouse_PAMPHLET_Groundwater%20Protection%20Awareness_September%202019.pdf): groundwater is stored in large volumes underground in aquifers and is tapped by boreholes. 'Ander' beperk die bewering tereg tot 'n deel van die reën.

items.bewering: 'n Dorp se water gaan eers na 'n suiweringswerk waar dit skoongemaak word. Pype en pompe bring dit daarna tot by die krane.
items.bron: Rand Water Infrastructure Development Plan, Parliament 2023 (https://www.parliament.gov.za/storage/app/media/Pages/2023/05-09-2023_Provincial_week/gauteng/13-09-2023/Rand_Water_Infrastructure_Development_Plan.pdf): raw water from the dam is treated (coagulation, sedimentation, filtration, chlorination) at Zuikerbosch, then pumped through pipelines and reservoirs to municipalities and taps; Mail & Guardian 2014 on Rand Water's pipeline and reservoir network.

items.bewering: 'n Dam vul wanneer dit reën waar sy riviere vandaan kom, dikwels ver weg.
items.bron: DWS statement on the Vaal Dam, January 2025, reported by Engineering News (https://www.engineeringnews.co.za/article/rainfall-boosts-south-africas-vaal-dams-water-storage-levels-2025-01-15): the rise came from 'good inflow because of recent rainfall in the catchment'; Mail & Guardian 2014: the Vaal system is also fed by water carried from the Tugela in KwaZulu-Natal.

items.bewering: Die riviere loop nog dae lank ná die reën by die dam in.
items.bron: Same DWS Vaal Dam report, January 2025 (https://www.engineeringnews.co.za/article/rainfall-boosts-south-africas-vaal-dams-water-storage-levels-2025-01-15): the dam rose from 24.3% to 46.2% and then 'overnight, the levels have again significantly increased to 50.53%', from continuing catchment inflow after the rain. Geld vir 'n dam waarvan die riviere ver kom, soos die blok dit stel; 'n klein plaasdam se stroompie kan gouer ophou loop, maar die sin praat nie daarvan nie.

items.bewering: Die dam vul op sy eie tyd, nie op ons s'n nie.
items.bron: Personifikasie, op die mapping nagegaan: dit beeld uit dat mense nie kan beheer wanneer en hoeveel 'n dam vul nie, omdat dit van reën in die opvanggebied afhang. Die DWS Vaal Dam-verslae (https://www.engineeringnews.co.za/article/rainfall-boosts-south-africas-vaal-dams-water-storage-levels-2025-01-15) skryf die daling toe aan lae invloei en verdamping en die styging aan reën in die opvanggebied. Die beeld lei 'n leerder nie na 'n vals gevolgtrekking nie.

items.bewering: 'n Droogte duur lank, en dit reën baie minder as gewoonlik. Die water in die dam sak dan laer en laer.
items.bron: UNDRR/PreventionWeb hazard definition citing WMO (https://www.undrr.org/understanding-disaster-risk/terminology/hips/mh0401): a prolonged deficiency of precipitation below a threshold; DWS Vaal Dam reports: the earlier decline came from low inflows owing to lack of rainfall, plus evaporation.

items.bewering: Die kraan is die einde van daardie lang pad en nie sy begin nie. (Ook die titel: 'Die water begin nie by die kraan nie'.)
items.bron: Beeldspraak, op die mapping nagegaan teen die volgorde wat die les self gee en wat die Rand Water-infrastruktuurplan bevestig (reën, rivier, dam, suiwering, pype en pompe, kraan). Die 'pad' pas punt vir punt. Dit hou op by die kraan en sê nie dat water daar 'eindig' in die sin dat dit verdwyn nie; 'n leerder wat verder redeneer, word nie misgelei nie.

items.bewering: In party huise is daar 'n kraan in die kombuis. Op ander plekke stap mense na 'n kraan wat die hele straat deel. Party gesinne haal water by 'n boorgat, 'n tenk of 'n rivier.
items.blok: Nie elke kraan is naby nie
items.bron: Stats SA General Household Survey, main source of drinking water variable, via DataFirst UCT (https://datafirst.uct.ac.za/dataportal/index.php/catalog/1144/variable/V347): categories include piped water inside the dwelling, piped water in the yard, public/communal taps, boreholes, water tanks and flowing water/streams/rivers.

items.bewering: Water is swaar, en iemand wat dit dra, weet presies hoeveel werk in een emmer sit.
items.blok: Nie elke kraan is naby nie
items.bron: Peer-reviewed Limpopo study of water carrying (Environmental Health 2010, https://doaj.org/article/5183a048090047c09c27a8076c581f59): mean container weight carried 19.5 kg, with two-thirds of carriers reporting spinal pain. 'Presies' is figuurlik en is geen getalsbewering nie.

items.bewering: 'n Lekkende kraan drup dag en nag, en dikwels merk niemand dit op nie. Sê dadelik vir 'n grootmens as 'n kraan drup of 'n pyp lek.
items.blok: Water raak weg sonder dat jy dit sien
items.bron: DWS via SAnews (https://www.sanews.gov.za/node/60214): leaks can waste a lot of water, especially if they are undetected and left for a long time; Western Cape Government, 'Simple ways to save water in your home' (https://www.westerncape.gov.za/simple-ways-save-water-your-home): check, fix and report leaking taps and pipes.

items.bewering: Water wat jy in die middagson op 'n tuin gooi, verdamp gou. Maak die tuin eerder vroegoggend of laatmiddag nat.
items.blok: Water raak weg sonder dat jy dit sien
items.bron: Western Cape Government (https://www.westerncape.gov.za/simple-ways-save-water-your-home): water at sunrise or sunset; South African municipal restrictions (City of Cape Town Level 3b; Sol Plaatje 2016 notice, https://www.kimberley.org.za/water-restrictions-continue-within-sol-plaatje-municipality/; Rand Water stage 2) allow watering only before 09:00 or after 18:00, for lower evaporation in the heat of the day.

items.bewering: Maak die kraan toe terwyl jy tande borsel of jou hande inseep.
items.blok: Wat jy self kan doen om water te spaar
items.bron: DWS water-saving tips via SAnews/gov.za (https://www.gov.za/water-saving-tips): do not run the tap while brushing teeth; use a tumbler or run the tap only to rinse; never leave taps running.

items.bewering: Stort korter of gooi minder water in die bad.
items.blok: Wat jy self kan doen om water te spaar
items.bron: Western Cape Government (https://www.westerncape.gov.za/simple-ways-save-water-your-home): take shorter showers; DWS tips (https://www.gov.za/water-saving-tips): a short shower uses far less water than a full bath.

items.bewering: Gooi die water waarin jy gebad het op die tuin uit.
items.blok: Wat jy self kan doen om water te spaar
items.bron: City of Cape Town, Alternative Water Resources: Greywater pamphlet (https://www.capetown.gov.za/_documents/resource.capetown.gov.za/documentcentre/Documents/Graphics%20and%20educational%20material/Alternative_Water_Resources_Greywater_English.pdf): greywater is water from baths, showers and basins and 'can be successfully used for garden irrigation'; Western Cape Government: reuse bath and shower water in the garden.

items.bewering: Was 'n motor met 'n emmer en 'n lap eerder as met 'n tuinslang.
items.blok: Wat jy self kan doen om water te spaar
items.bron: City of Cape Town Level 3b restrictions (2018) as reported (https://businesstech.co.za/news/general/103725/10-tips-on-how-to-save-water/): vehicles may be washed only with a bucket, no hosepipes; Rand Water stage 2 restrictions: no vehicle washing with a hose.

items.bewering: Vang reënwater in 'n tenk of 'n drom op.
items.blok: Wat jy self kan doen om water te spaar
items.bron: DWS household water-saving measures via SAnews (https://www.sanews.gov.za/node/60214): invest in a rainwater harvesting system and use the water for gardens, car washing and paving; City of Cape Town 'Alternative Water Resources: 3 Ways' pamphlet (rainwater harvesting).

items.bewering: Vuil water lyk soms heeltemal skoon, en tog is daar kieme in.
items.bron: Hesperian Health Guides, 'Clean water' (https://en.hesperian.org/hhg/Helping_Children_Live_with_HIV:Clean_water): 'You cannot tell that water is safe to drink by how it looks. Water that looks clean may still contain harmful germs'.

items.bewering: Daardie kieme kan 'n mens siek maak en veral diarree gee.
items.bron: WHO Drinking-water fact sheet (https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/drinking-water): faecal microbial contamination is the greatest risk, and contaminated water transmits diarrhoea, cholera, dysentery, typhoid and polio; about 1 million deaths a year from diarrhoea linked to unsafe water, sanitation and hygiene. Diarrhoea is the main disease named, so 'veral' holds.

items.bewering: Wat in 'n stormwaterdrein beland, word nie soos kraanwater skoongemaak nie. Dit loop reguit in 'n rivier of in die see uit.
items.bron: City of Cape Town, Coastal Water Quality FAQ (https://resource.capetown.gov.za/documentcentre/Documents/Procedures,%20guidelines%20and%20regulations/Coastal%20Water%20Quality%20FAQ.pdf): the stormwater network carries water from road-side inlets through underground mains to the sea 'without treatment or dilution'; Daily Maverick 2018: stormwater runs via ponds and channels into rivers and then the sea. 'Reguit' is reg in die sin van 'onbehandeld'. Die water loop soms deur vleie of kanale, en die sin ontken dit nie.

items.bewering: Stroomaf drink diere uit daardie rivier, en mense haal ook water daaruit.
items.bron: Stats SA GHS via DataFirst (https://datafirst.uct.ac.za/dataportal/index.php/catalog/1144/variable/V347): some households draw drinking water from streams and rivers; Daily Maverick 2021 (https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2021-11-25-winnie-madikizela-mandelas-tapless-impoverished-hometown-no-country-for-old-women.md): families in Mbizana fetch water from the river.

items.bewering: Gooi vullis in 'n asblik, nooit in 'n rivier of 'n drein nie.
items.blok: Hoe ons die water skoon hou
items.bron: City of Cape Town Coastal Water Quality FAQ: the stormwater system should carry rainfall runoff only, and dumping in it pollutes the sea; Daily Maverick 2021 on the directive to trap general waste at stormwater outlets feeding the Diep River.

items.bewering: Gooi olie, verf en paraffien nooit op die grond of in 'n drein nie.
items.blok: Hoe ons die water skoon hou
items.bron: City of Ekurhuleni (https://www.ekurhuleni.gov.za/press-releases/public-engagements/residents-urged-to-refrain-from-disposing-oil-in-public-spaces-or-pouring-it-over-objects-to-deter-loitering/): oil poured into drains or on the ground contaminates rivers and streams; ACT Government, 'Preventing pollution from painting' (https://www.accesscanberra.act.gov.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0011/2297063/Preventing-pollution-from-painting.pdf): paint and solvents are hazardous waste and are never put into stormwater. Geen Suid-Afrikaanse bron noem paraffien spesifiek nie, maar paraffien is 'n petroleumoplosmiddel en val onder dieselfde reël; die opdrag is nie in twyfel nie.

items.bewering: Was met seep in 'n bak en nie in die rivier self nie.
items.blok: Hoe ons die water skoon hou
items.bron: Leave No Trace (https://lnt.org/skills-series-how-to-do-your-dishes-in-the-backcountry/) and Alberta Health, 'Keeping clean in the backcountry' (https://myhealth.alberta.ca/Alberta/Pages/keeping-clean-backcountry.aspx): wash with soap well away from the water's edge, about 60 m, because even biodegradable soap harms rivers and streams.

items.bewering: Hou diere weg van die plek waar mense drinkwater haal.
items.blok: Hoe ons die water skoon hou
items.bron: Alberta Agriculture, livestock and water source protection (https://www1.agriculture.alberta.ca/$department/deptdocs.nsf/all/agdex927/$file/576-4.pdf): keeping livestock out of water sources and providing alternative watering stops animal waste entering the water; Ireland EPA farming guidance: sources used for drinking need protection from livestock (Cryptosporidium).

items.bewering: 'n Toilet moet ver staan van 'n boorgat of 'n stroom waar mense water haal.
items.blok: Hoe ons die water skoon hou
items.bron: Frontiers in Water 2025 (https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/water/articles/10.3389/frwa.2025.1561777/epub): a general guideline of at least 30 m between a pit latrine and any water source; DFID DEWPoint review of national safe-distance regulations (https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/57a08b3c40f0b652dd000ba6/DEWPoint_A0304_Nov2009_National_regulations_safe_distance_latrines.pdf). Die les noem geen afstand nie, dus raak die konflik tussen bronne oor die getal (10 m tot 30 m en meer) dit nie. Die reël geld vir 'n putlatrine of septiese tenk, nie vir 'n spoeltoilet aan 'n riool nie; die sin is 'n waar riglyn en leer niks vals nie.

items.bewering: Hou die emmer met drinkwater toe en gooi die water uit sonder om jou hande in te steek.
items.blok: Hoe ons die water skoon hou
items.bron: CDC Safe Water System, safe storage guidance (https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/79547): use a covered container, take water out by pouring rather than dipping, and do not put in hands or objects; CAWST via SSWM: the storage container must be covered.

items.bewering: dam: Water wat agter 'n muur of 'n grondwal opgevang en gebêre word. Die muur staan dikwels dwars oor 'n rivier of stroom.
items.bron: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries, 'dam' (https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/dam): a barrier across a river holding back water; South African sense: an artificial lake where rain or spring water is collected and stored. In Afrikaans dui 'dam' gewoonlik die opgegaarde water aan en 'damwal' die muur, dus pas die omskrywing. 'Dikwels' laat tereg ruimte vir plaasdamme wat afloop opvang sonder dat 'n rivier daardeur loop.

items.bewering: droogte: 'n Lang tyd waarin dit baie minder reën as gewoonlik.
items.bron: UNDRR hazard information profile citing WMO (https://www.undrr.org/understanding-disaster-risk/terminology/hips/mh0401): 'a prolonged deficiency of precipitation below a certain threshold'; WMO/UNESCO 2012: a prolonged absence or marked shortfall of precipitation.

items.bewering: suiweringswerk: Die plek waar water skoongemaak word voordat dit by die krane uitkom.
items.bron: Rand Water Infrastructure Development Plan 2023 (Zuikerbosch treatment works): raw water is cleaned at the works before distribution to taps. Net die betekenis is nagegaan; die woordvorm is 'n taalsaak en nie in hierdie verslag se bestek nie.

items.bewering: boorgat: 'n Nou gat wat diep in die grond geboor word en waaruit water gepomp word.
items.bron: FAO AGROVOC 'boreholes' (https://agrovoc.fao.org/browse/agrovoc/en/page/c_9dc4c81e) and EPFL Graph Search (https://graphsearch.epfl.ch/concept/235902): a borehole is a narrow shaft drilled into the ground, commonly to reach groundwater, which a pump brings up; DWS groundwater pamphlet: boreholes tap groundwater.

items.bewering: stormwaterdrein: Die gat in die straat wat reënwater van die pad af wegvat.
items.bron: City of Cape Town Coastal Water Quality FAQ: rainwater enters the stormwater network through road-side inlets and runs through underground mains. Die omskrywing noem net die inlaat wat 'n kind kan sien, en nie die pype daaragter nie. Dit is 'n vereenvoudiging, maar nie 'n onwaarheid nie, en dit stem ooreen met die studieblok se 'wat in 'n stormwaterdrein beland'.

items.bewering: verdamp: Wanneer water in die lug optrek en 'n nat plek daardeur droër word.
items.bron: UN ESCWA SD glossary 'evaporation' (https://www.unescwa.org/sd-glossary/evaporation) and Dictionary.com 'evaporation': liquid water changes into water vapour at the surface and goes into the air, which is why a puddle dries. Die omskrywing is waar. Dit noem nie dat die water 'n onsigbare gas (waterdamp) word nie, en lees alleen kan dit die indruk laat dat druppels opstyg. Dit is egter weglating en nie 'n vals bewering nie.

items.bewering: kieme: Baie klein lewende dinge wat 'n mens siek kan maak.
items.bron: KidsHealth (Nemours), 'Germs: Bacteria, Viruses, Fungi, and Protozoa' (https://KidsHealth.org/en/parents/germs.html): germs are microscopic bacteria, viruses, fungi and protozoa that can cause disease. Voorbehoud vir 'n mens: of virusse 'lewend' is, is 'n definisievraag wat wetenskaplikes nog debatteer ('they aren't even a full cell'). Bakterieë, swamme en protosoë is wel lewend, en 'kan' maak geen bewering oor elke kiem nie. Dit word as bevestig aangeteken omdat dit 'n klassifikasiekonvensie is en nie 'n feitefout nie.

opsomming: Al 39 bewerings in hierdie rondte is van voor af nagegaan en almal is bevestig, meestal teen Suid-Afrikaanse regerings- en munisipale bronne (DWS, Stats SA, Stad Kaapstad, Wes-Kaapse Regering, Rand Water) en WHO/CDC; die les bevat geen superlatiewe nie, die twee beelde ('die kraan is die einde van daardie lang pad', 'die dam vul op sy eie tyd') se mapping hou, en die enigste punte wat 'n mens moet weet is dat die kieme-omskrywing virusse as 'lewend' tel (dit is 'n debatteerde klassifikasie, nie 'n fout nie), dat die toiletreël eintlik vir putlatrines geld, en dat die verdamp-omskrywing waar is maar nie noem dat water 'n onsigbare damp word nie.
